title: Google Font Selection — Live Catalog + LLM Association
short_summary: selects and ranks the top 5 google fonts for any keyword, phrase, or reference image using live google fonts catalog tag scores, complete with specimen urls, css2 embed tags, and an interactive specimen viewer.
when_to_use: use whenever you pass a keyword ('soft', 'warm editorial', 'developer cli') or design brief and want 5 non-copied google font recommendations.
summary: Find the right Google Fonts for ANY word, phrase, brief, or image ("wacky", "mobster", "y2k", "warm leather atelier", a UI screenshot, a poster). Pulls Google's LIVE catalog data at run time (official tag scores from google/fonts + fonts.google.com metadata, ~1,950 families), uses an LLM to associate the request with Google's official Feeling/Appearance tags, and ranks the whole catalog on Google's own 0-100 scores. Returns an honest Top 5 with specimen URLs, CSS2 embeds, variable axes, download methods, and the equivalent fonts.google.com filter URL. No snapshot, no keyword dictionary. Use whenever a user wants font recommendations from a keyword, mood, brand brief, or image.
